title: Suspend BitLocker protection temporarily
description: Suspend BitLocker protection temporarily (useful for BIOS or firmware updates).

parameters.name: rebootCount
parameters.label: Number of restarts
parameters.description: Number of restarts before protection resumes automatically

examples.description: Suspend BitLocker for 1 restart (resumes automatically afterwards)
Suspend BitLocker for 2 restarts (multi-step BIOS update)
Suspend BitLocker indefinitely until resumed by hand
Suspend BitLocker on every protected volume for 1 restart

notes: ⚠️ While suspended, the disk stays ENCRYPTED but is ACCESSIBLE without authentication! Use it only for maintenance (BIOS, firmware, drivers). RebootCount=0: suspended until Resume-BitLocker. RebootCount=1+: resumes automatically after N restarts.

fr.title: Suspendre temporairement la protection BitLocker
fr.description: Suspend la protection BitLocker temporairement (utile pour mises à jour BIOS/firmware).
fr.notes: ⚠️ Durant la suspension, le disque reste CHIFFRÉ mais ACCESSIBLE sans authentification! Utilisez uniquement pour maintenance (BIOS, firmware, drivers). RebootCount=0: suspension permanente jusqu'à Resume-BitLocker. RebootCount=1+: réactivation automatique après N redémarrages.

rebootCount.label: Nombre de redémarrages
rebootCount.description: Nombre de redémarrages avant réactivation automatique
